# Stage recap — Style Prompt

> A 16:9 story recap packaged for a 9:16 feed as a stage. The landscape footage plays in a full-width window across the middle of the frame, framed by two tapered champagne-gold hairlines, with a gold progress bar creeping along its lower edge. Behind it the same picture fills the whole frame, blurred, darkened and vignetted. A fixed two-line hook headline sits above the window all film long (a gold-outlined kicker pill, heavy ivory lines with one or two gold words, a frosted subhead); timed packaging slides in and out: a name tag "name | role", a data card "number | label", a quote card, and a few short emotional callouts. Below the window, big two-layer soft-glow subtitles light one or two key words. Calm, premium, steady: the edit and the words do the work.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **One stage for the whole film.** The headline, the window, the hairlines and the progress bar never move; only the footage, the subtitles and the timed cards change. The viewer always knows what story this is.
2. **The hook is printed.** The headline states the promise in two lines (the stake on line one, the turn on line two), lit gold on its two key phrases. It is the thumbnail and the title at once.
3. **Packaging adds, never repeats.** A name tag replaces the narration's biography, a data card holds the number the narration only mentions, a callout adds subtext in 8–10 letters. Once a name tag has shown who someone is, the subtitles never say it again.
4. **Restraint.** 3–5 callouts per minute, at the hook, a big turn and the reveal; one card at a time; nothing over the subtitles.

Not a meme template (no white bars with black text, no emoji, no shaking zooms), not a news package (no ticker, no lower-third crawl, no channel bug), not a vertical crop of the footage (faces are never cut by a 9:16 crop: the whole 16:9 frame stays visible).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Footage**: the user's 16:9 clip (`list_media`) used twice. In the window (`#vp`, 1080 × 608 at y 584, `object-fit: cover`, `focus_y` ≈ 0.42 when the clip is taller) inside `.cam` for slow pushes; and as the backdrop: the same clip covering 1080 × 1920 with one static filter on its wrapper (`blur(40px) brightness(0.82) saturate(1.1) contrast(1.04)`), never tweened. If the clip has burned-in subtitles, crop them off in the window (≈ 13 % of its height). Other aspects: 16:10, 4:3 and 1:1 windows keep the same stage (a 4:3 window is 810 px tall and starts at y 436). The example paints stand-in shots once on canvases (a coffee cart at night and by day, a table with money, a dawn terminal) and their blurred quarter-size copies.
- **Vignettes over the backdrop**: from the top to the window, `--latar` at 80 % → 53 %; from the window's bottom edge to the frame's bottom, 57 % → 91 %. A 28 px shadow (53 % → 0) above and below the window keeps it punchy.
- **Hairlines**: 2 px at y 582 and y 1192, full width, a gold that brightens toward the centre and fades to 25 % at both ends.
- **Progress bar**: 4 px on the window's lower edge, a gold gradient with a bright tip, sliding in from the left over the whole film (linear).
- **Header** (centred, from y 168): kicker pill 24 px heavy, padding 8 × 22, `--latar` 84 % with a 1.5 px gold ring; 16 px gap; two title lines 44 px heavy, 14 px apart, ivory with a 1.8 px dark stroke and a soft drop shadow; a frosted subhead box (radius 12, `--teks` at 9 % with a 1 px ring at 20 %), 25 px.
- **Cards** (radius 14–16, `--latar-2` at 89 %, a 1–1.5 px gold ring, a soft shadow): the name tag (an 8 px gold bar inside the left edge, name 32 px heavy, role 22 px), the data card (number 44 px heavy gold, label 23 px), the quote card (a 48 px gold opening quote mark, the quote 30 px heavy, "— speaker" 21 px gold). They sit inside the window, 38 px from the side and 16 px above its lower edge.
- **Callouts**: ≤ 8–10 letters without end punctuation, 36 px heavy gold (or coral) with a 2.2 px dark stroke, a small diamond before the word, a tapered underline, on a soft dark scrim. Slots: centred 20 px under the window, or inside the window's top corners (18 px down; 84 px from the right edge, 38 px from the left).
- **Subtitles**: 54 px heavy, one line of ≤ ~26 characters, centred, baseline 396 px above the frame's bottom (≈ y 1524), 52 px side margins. Two layers: a soft glow (a thick dark outline, softened) under a sharp line with a 3.2 px dark outline and a small shadow.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--utama` is the champagne gold of the stage: hairlines, kicker ring, card rings and bars, callout diamonds and underlines, the progress bar. `--utama-di-latar` is the gold for words: highlighted title phrases, highlighted subtitle words, the data card's number, the quote mark and the callout text.
- `--aksen` (coral) is the second callout style, for warmth or a twist; `--aksen-di-latar` for its text.
- `--latar` darkens the backdrop, outlines every word and is the kicker fill; `--latar-2` is the card surface.
- `--teks` ivory carries the title lines, names and quotes; `--teks-redup` the roles, labels and subhead.
- Look-owned: `--sub`, the warm pale gold of the subtitles (40 % gold word colour in `--teks`), and `--emas-terang`, the bright centre of the hairlines. The footage keeps its own colours (the stand-in's `--f-*`).
- A light brand turns the stage into a pale frosted room with dark headline and subtitles: correct; the window and the footage stay as they are.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the kicker, the headline, card names and numbers, callouts and subtitles, all at the heaviest weight (Inter 800 in the example; the source uses a Black CJK sans). Archivo Black or Poppins 800 also suit.
- `--font-isi` carries the subhead and the card roles and labels at 600.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: kicker 24, title 44 (shrinks in 4 px steps until a line fits 88 % of the width), subhead 25, name 32, role 22, data number 44, label 23, quote 30, speaker 21, callout 36, subtitle 54. In the 16:9 sample the subtitle is 48.
- Subtitle lines are short: one line, about 26 characters at 54 px; split longer sentences into consecutive lines on the beat.

## 5. Motion quality

- **The stage is static.** Headline, hairlines and window do not animate; the progress bar is the only constant motion.
- **Cards and callouts**: fade in over 0.24–0.25 s while sliding 22 px in from their own side (left slot from the left, right slot from the right) or rising 14 px (centre slot), the slide eased quadratically over 0.18 s; fade out over 0.24 s. A card holds ≥ 3 s, a callout 1.5–3.5 s.
- **Subtitles**: fade in 70 ms, out 56 ms; a pause of ≤ 0.34 s keeps the old line until the new one (no blank flicker between sentences); never cross a beat owned by original dialogue.
- **Footage**: hard cuts; each shot pushed slowly 1.00 → 1.06 over its length, linear.
- **Sound** (when used): a soft whoosh on the hook's first cut and a warm impact on the reveal, 2–4 per minute at most, never over original dialogue.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Slow push 1.00 → 1.06 inside the window | keep watching, the story is moving | every shot |
| Hard cut inside the window (stage holds) | the next moment of the same story | the default |
| Punch to ~1.25 on a face for one beat | this reaction matters | a decision, a shock, a quote |
| Hold a wide shot, no push | the result, the place | the reveal, the ending |
| Window cut to a still frame with the data card | a fact pauses the story | numbers, dates, prices |

The frame itself never moves: no zoom of the stage, no shake.

## 7. Native moves

- **Printed hook.** Kicker pill (series or episode), two heavy lines with the stake and the turn lit gold, a frosted line of where and how long. *Fits content like:* "Utang 70 juta warisan ayah / lunas dari gerobak kopi"; a shop's "Dari 3 pesanan sehari / jadi 300"; a creator's recap of a match; a class's "Nilai 40 jadi 90 dalam 1 semester".
- **Name tag instead of narration.** "name | role" slides in bottom left inside the window when the person first appears. *Fits content like:* the owner of a stall; a player and their position; a teacher and her school; a character in a drama recap.
- **Data card.** "number | label" from the right, the number in gold. *Fits content like:* a debt, a price, followers gained, a score, days without rain.
- **Quote card.** The person's own sentence with a big gold quote mark and "— name". *Fits content like:* a customer's review; a coach's line; a student's confession; a villain's threat.
- **Short callout.** 8–10 letters of subtext the narration does not say, under the window or in a top corner of it. *Fits content like:* "Nekat buka", "Titik balik", "Lunas!", "Kena tipu", "Juara".
- **Gold-lit subtitle.** One or two words per line in gold: the number, the turn, the result. *Fits content like:* "utang 70 juta", "gerobak kopi", "lunas"; a price in a promo; the twist word in a story.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Collisions.** Cards, callouts and subtitles each have their own slot; never let a card enter the subtitle band (from ~2.4 subtitle heights above its baseline) or two timed items share a slot at the same time.
- **Repeating the narration.** A callout that says what the subtitle says is wasted; a name tag that repeats the narration's description is too.
- **Long callouts.** More than 10 letters becomes a sentence; cut it.
- **Cropping the 16:9 clip to fill 9:16.** The window keeps the whole frame; the backdrop fills the rest.
- **Hard-coded subtitle text in footage.** Crop it off in the window; the backdrop blur hides it.
- **Performance**: the backdrop blur is static: a fixed filter on the backdrop clip's wrapper, or (cheaper in the live preview) a still of the shot from `list_media` blurred once and swapped on each cut; cards move by transform and opacity only; no animated blur, no `backdrop-filter` for the frosted subhead (a flat 9 % layer fakes it).
- **Wrong words.** Narration and dialogue from a transcript need checking for names and figures before rendering.

## Measured from the references

From the source's packaging code at 1080 × 1920: a 16:9 window 1080 × 608 at y 584 (4:3: 810 tall at y 436), header top at y 168 (124 when the window starts above y 460), hairlines 2 px on both window edges, a 4 px progress bar on the lower edge, subtitles 54 px with a 396 px bottom margin and 52 px side margins, glow blur 3.2, fade 70 ms in, a 0.34 s bridge; cards 16 px above the window's bottom edge and 38 px from its side; callouts 20 px under the window or 18 px inside its top; card and callout motion: 22 px slide or 14 px rise over 0.18 s (quadratic), 0.24–0.25 s fades; backdrop: quarter-size box blur (10 px, 2 passes), brightness −0.18, saturation +10 %, contrast +4 %.

# Stage recap: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3.5, long 5.

## hook

- en: the fixed two-line hook headline over the stage, the strongest shot in the window, a gold name tag slides in bottom left
- id: judul pengait dua baris tetap di atas panggung, gambar terkuat di jendela, papan nama bertepi emas bergeser masuk di kiri bawah

## problem

- en: the trouble in the window, the subtitle lights its key word gold, a short callout (8-10 letters) rises under the window
- id: masalahnya di jendela, subtitle menyalakan kata kuncinya emas, teks hias pendek (8-10 huruf) naik di bawah jendela

## fact

- en: a detail shot in the window; a quote card with the person's own words slides in bottom left, the subtitle names the source
- id: gambar detail di jendela; kartu kutipan berisi kata-kata tokohnya bergeser masuk di kiri bawah, subtitle menyebut sumbernya

## step

- en: hard cuts in the window, one subtitle line per cut, a callout top right of the window names each step in a few letters
- id: potongan keras di jendela, satu baris subtitle per potong, teks hias di kanan atas jendela menamai tiap langkah singkat

## compare

- en: two shots cut back and forth, a data card for each side slides in from its own edge, the subtitle lights the gap
- id: dua gambar dipotong bolak-balik, kartu data tiap sisi masuk dari tepinya masing-masing, subtitle menyalakan selisihnya

## number

- en: a held shot in the window, a data card 'number | label' slides in from the right, the number in gold
- id: gambar yang ditahan di jendela, kartu data 'angka | label' bergeser masuk dari kanan, angkanya emas

## proof

- en: the person in the window, a quote card in their words slides in bottom left, a coral callout top right of the window
- id: tokohnya di jendela, kartu kutipan dengan kata-katanya masuk di kiri bawah, teks hias koral di kanan atas jendela

## offer

- en: the product or place in the window, a data card with the price from the right, a callout with the deal under the window
- id: produk atau tempatnya di jendela, kartu data berisi harga dari kanan, teks hias penawarannya di bawah jendela

## cta

- en: a calm shot, the subtitle carries the contact with its key word gold, a callout under the window, held 2-3 s
- id: gambar yang tenang, subtitle membawa kontaknya dengan kata kunci emas, teks hias di bawah jendela, diam 2-3 dtk

## payoff

- en: the hook's place again, changed; the last subtitle lights the outcome word, a one-word callout rises and holds 3 s
- id: tempat pembuka lagi, sudah berubah; subtitle terakhir menyalakan kata hasilnya, teks hias satu kata naik dan diam 3 dtk

    <style>

      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0d1017; --latar-2: #101218; --utama: #d9b870; --aksen: #e08a70;
        --teks: #faf6ee; --teks-redup: #d0d4dc; --teks-di-utama: #14100c; --teks-di-aksen: #18100e;
        --utama-di-latar: #f6ce6e; --aksen-di-latar: #f2a890;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya ini: subtitle emas pucat (campuran emas + teks), emas terang di tengah garis. */
        --sub: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama-di-latar) 40%, var(--teks));
        --emas-terang: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 70%, var(--teks));
        /* Rekaman pengganti (jalan malam, meja, terminal subuh): tetap di semua brand. */
        --f-malam: #1b2140; --f-malam2: #3a2c4a; --f-lampu: #ffb45c; --f-hangat: #ffe1a8; --f-kayu: #6b4428; --f-kayu2: #3a2416;
        --f-gelap: #0c0a0d; --f-kulit: #c08a64; --f-uang: #9fb8a0; --f-subuh: #f2a86a; --f-subuh2: #7d6f8c; --f-siang: #9cc3dd; --f-siang2: #f4e2c0;
        --f-bus: #2c3448; --f-hijau: #3f6b4a;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .scene, .full { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; }
      .scene { visibility: hidden; } #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      .a { position: absolute; } .H { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Panggung: salinan rekaman yang dikaburkan dan digelapkan (dilukis sekali), vinyet atas dan bawah. */
      #bg img, .cam img { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; visibility: hidden; }
      #vig { background: linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 80%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 53%, transparent) 584px, transparent 584px, transparent 1192px,
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 57%, transparent) 1192px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 91%, transparent)); }
      /* Jendela 16:9 selebar layar (y 584-1192), bayangan di atas dan bawahnya, garis emas meruncing, bilah kemajuan emas. */
      #vp { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 584px; width: 1080px; height: 608px; overflow: hidden; }
      .cam { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .bay { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1080px; height: 28px; }
      .emas { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1080px; height: 2px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 25%, transparent), var(--emas-terang) 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 25%, transparent)); }
      #prog { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 1188px; width: 1080px; height: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
      #prog i { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--utama), var(--emas-terang) 96%, var(--teks)); }
      /* Judul pengait tetap di atas: pil kicker, dua baris judul dengan kata kunci emas, subjudul di kotak buram. */
      #head { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 168px; width: 1080px; text-align: center; }
      .kick { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 29px; color: var(--utama-di-latar);
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 84%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 76%, transparent); }
      .tl { display: block; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 44px; line-height: 53px; color: var(--teks); white-space: nowrap;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 3.6px var(--latar); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 5px 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 72%, transparent); }
      .tl:first-of-type { margin-top: 16px; } .hl { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .subh { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; padding: 9px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teks-redup);
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 9%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 20%, transparent); }
      /* Subtitle dua lapis: lapis cahaya (garis tebal gelap yang dilembutkan) di bawah, teks tajam bergaris di atas; 1-2 kata menyala. */
      .sub { position: absolute; left: 52px; width: 976px; bottom: 396px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 54px; line-height: 64px;
        color: var(--sub); white-space: nowrap; -webkit-text-stroke: 6.4px var(--latar); paint-order: stroke fill; opacity: 0;
        text-shadow: 0 0 6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, transparent), 0 0 14px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 55%, transparent), 0 2px 2px var(--latar); }
      .sub b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      /* Kartu berwaktu: papan gelap bertepi emas, bilah emas tegak di kiri. */
      .crd { position: absolute; padding: 14px 18px 16px 38px; border-radius: 14px; white-space: nowrap; visibility: hidden;
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2) 89%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 73%, transparent), 0 6px 18px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 60%, transparent); }
      .crd::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; bottom: 16px; width: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--utama); }
      .crd .n { font-size: 32px; line-height: 40px; } .crd .r { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 28px; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #data { padding: 14px 28px 18px 40px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 76%, transparent), 0 6px 18px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 60%, transparent); }
      #data .n { font-size: 44px; line-height: 52px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); } #data .r { font-size: 23px; color: var(--teks); }
      #kutip { padding: 18px 34px 20px 48px; border-radius: 16px; }
      #kutip::before { display: none; } #kutip .n { font-size: 30px; } #kutip .r { color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-size: 21px; }
      #kutip .q { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 4px; font-size: 48px; line-height: 60px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      /* Teks hias (maks. 8-10 huruf): titik belah ketupat, teks tebal bergaris, garis bawah meruncing, alas gelap lembut. */
      .co { position: absolute; padding: 18px 26px 22px 48px; border-radius: 18px; white-space: nowrap; visibility: hidden;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 55%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 35%, transparent) 70%, transparent); }
      .co .t { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 36px; line-height: 44px; color: var(--utama-di-latar);
        -webkit-text-stroke: 4.4px var(--latar); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 4px 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, transparent); }
      .co.mid { left: 0; right: 0; margin: 0 auto; width: fit-content; }
      .co.coral .t { color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      .co::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 26px; top: 34px; width: 12px; height: 12px; transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--utama); }
      .co.coral::before, .co.coral .u { background: var(--aksen); }
      .co .u { height: 3px; margin: 6px 0 0 -22px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--utama), color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 25%, transparent)); }
      .co.coral .u { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--aksen), color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 25%, transparent)); }
